Can’t Miss, Don’t Misd
Aug 2019 • Family
Like most places in Vietnam, this place doesn’t look like much from the outside. But once you enter the quaint decor is reminiscent of a war museum. This is for good reason as the name of the restaurant is 1986, referring to one of many ‘wars’ between China and Vietnam. 

Once inside you will be greeted by that signature Vietnam smile that is so warming and welcoming. Having worked our way through the menu with the assistance of some English translation and the free wifi, we placed our order.

We ordered sweet potato rice, fried squid, lemon shrimp and eggplant and mushroom in soy sauce. The dishes were amazing and very generous. A hint of Chili in the eggplant. Free jasmine tea. 

We would highly recommend this place it is about 8 min walk from the DaNang train station if you turn left.

One day tour in Da Nang
Jul 2018 • Friends
A hidden gem. Our hotel staff in HoiAn recommended this place instead of Madame Lan for a truly unique and authentic meal experience. Prices are very affordable and portions are small so don’t hesitate to double up. 

The restaurant is not upscale for tourist but the space and decor are very unique. 

Menus are local so ask for an English menu.

Good AC and fans upstairs.

For three of us:
1. Morning glory sautéed with garlic
2. Hot & sour soup with fish (ask for the Fish of the day). This is similar to Thai style soup. Canh cá
3. Pork belly in coconut juice 
4. Braised Pork ribs (sweet sauce)
5. Fried crispy (Japanese) Fish (trung cá)
6. Shrimp and pork in caramel sauce 
7. White rice

Coffee and drinks were interesting because locals like them very sweet so we have to ask for reduced sugar and without it. 

1. DaNang coffee does not taste strong but is good. Come espresso style on ice so must tell them if you don’t want ice or sugar.
Black coffee comes with sugar added so you will need to ask before ordering.

2. Nước cóc (freshly squeezed juice from this very interesting fruit) was devine. A MUST try.

3. Coconut coffee (ice blended cold drinks) was very nice. Come in a big mason jar. It is better than Starbucks coconut Frappuccino.

All of this cost us less than 360,000VND ($15 USD).
